sn32.3-12:1.2: nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn32.3-12:1.3: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sītavalāhakānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjatīti || || 4
sn32.3-12:1.4: Idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena sucaritaṃ carati vācāya sucaritaṃ carati manasā sucaritaṃ carati ||
sn32.3-12:1.6: Sītavalāhakā devā dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulā ti || || 5
sn32.3-12:1.8: Ahovatāham kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maranā sītavalāhakānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjeyyanti ||
sn32.3-12:1.11: So kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sītavalāhakānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati || || 6
sn32.3-12:1.12: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayam paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā Sītavahālakānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || 1-3
